info.title: Matterport Universal API
info.description: Access Matterport's GraphQL APIs for searching spaces, reading model details, managing model metadata, and working with model assets.

get.description: Retrieves access details for a Matterport model.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

schema.default: query GetModelAccess($modelId: ID!, $pageSize: Int = 25, $offset: String) { model(id: $modelId) { id access(pageSize: $pageSize, offset: $offset) { nextOffset results { id } } } }

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of access records to return.

schema.description: Maximum number of access records to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset returned by the previous access response.

schema.description: Pagination offset returned by the previous access response.

nextOffset.description: Offset token for the next page when present.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.description: Retrieves models from your Matterport account.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Hidden GraphQL query for listing models.

schema.description: Hidden GraphQL query for listing models.
schema.default: query ListModels($modelQuery: String = "*", $pageSize: Int = 10, $offset: String) { models(query: $modelQuery, pageSize: $pageSize, offset: $offset) { totalResults nextOffset results { id name created modified visibility accessVisibility state demo internalId } } }

parameters.name: modelQuery
parameters.description: Matterport model search query. Use * for all active models.

schema.description: Matterport model search query. Use * for all active models.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of models to return.

schema.description: Maximum number of models to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Next page offset returned by a previous models query.

schema.description: Next page offset returned by a previous models query.

nextOffset.description: Offset token for the next page when present.
